text:
maria.s: Heads-up — prod deploy for release v1.2.7-hotfix scheduled in ~20m. Need clarity on who can press and whether deploy-bot OTP fallback is enabled for oncall.

alex.k: I'm listed as oncall backup but I don't see the 'release_press' role in my profile. who currently has it?

paul (oncall): trying to press earlier and got a 403. deploy-bot returned 'mfa_missing'. I thought I was delegated yesterday.

eng-release-lead: We rotated the deployer SA keys last night and spun the delegate flow. JIT should have given paul access but MFA window is strict. I'll check the delegate audit now.

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED: Attempted press by paul (paul) -> DENIED (mfa_missing). Logs: https://internal/deploy/logs/press/1769902468 

maria.s: Could we enable an OTP fallback (TOTP) for a short window (15-60m) so oncall can press in emergencies? Need to avoid blocking the release. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tara: OTP fallback requires a two-approver exception from release owners/security. We can grant a 1h exception for this change window if two approvers sign off.

alex.k: I approve the exception. @bryan?

bryan: approve — fine with 1h. but add a clear rollback and pin the release before pressing.

maria.s: Added to release notes: "pin v1.2.7-hotfix; rollback plan: revert to v1.2.6, DB migrations are noop for this patch; auto-rollback threshold = error_rate > 1.5%"

eng-release-lead: Ok OTP fallback enabled for 60m. Audit note: exception id EXC-2026-199. Paul, please retry and attach your OTP code when prompted.

paul (oncall): retrying now. command used: `deploy push --release v1.2.7-hotfix --pin`

deploy-bot: AUTOMATED: press accepted by paul (paul). Rollout started on prod — canary=10%. Tracking id: R-1769902468.

paul (oncall): canary health looks stable at 5m, no error spike. scaling to 50%.

maria.s: note for ops — if error spike >1.5% OR latency > 200ms P95 rollback to v1.2.6 and open incident in #incidents.

paul (oncall): noted, monitoring dashboards up. Will call rollback if anything crosses thresholds. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
